'''Jyml''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who resided in the [[Damotite]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] village on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. On one occasion, Jyml lost several [[Limb/Legends|toes]] while working in the village's mine, despite wearing protective boots at the [[Time/Legends|time]]. Jyml later [[Death/Legends|died]] of old age at some point prior to the [[Battle of Lanteeb|liberation]] of Lanteeb during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
